development_tools_and_models.notes: Development models/runtime versions are observed per project chat; current host settings are distinct from historical settings. Coding-model temperature/output defaults were not exported.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: Codex app tools and browser/computer-use runtime/guidance were used. Other personally installed plugins are omitted; no custom project plugin or account integration was configured.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Current successful model is gemini-3.1-flash-lite. Exact earlier instructions/settings/schema snapshots include real attempts that failed; they are not certified successes or current defaults.

skills.notes: Two active project skills. Removed setup experiment skills are archived and not-used for implementation. Installed built-in guidance snapshots are current reference copies; earlier exact built-in versions are not-exportable.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: Normal root instructions and named historical versions. Six temporary collaboration tasks inherited gpt-6.1-sol/high; no standalone custom agent definition. Some exact encrypted historical prompts are not-exportable.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: Scripts are manual commands, not hooks. Custom project hooks: not-used. Host bundled turn-ended notify integration is documented without its machine executable path; no hook is required for replay.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Active application instructions are separate from source text. Captured earlier prompts/schema are named snapshots. Selected original user instructions are in the usage note; full chat logs are excluded.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Applicable host node_repl/browser configuration only. Executable paths, pipe instances and trust hashes omitted with reasons. Custom project MCP server: not-used; application replay has no MCP dependency.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Observed permission layers and all recognized application environment names recorded. No keys/authentication/private URLs. Examples are documentation; original personal settings were not changed.
